title: SpEL calls a function bound to a Java receiver
summary: A parsed SpEL function now invokes its bound Java receiver and sees a replacement binding on the next evaluation.

change.description: SpEL can invoke MethodHandle values under its existing function syntax. StandardEvaluationContext gains a registerFunction overload for handles.

notes: The receiver is captured with a public JDK method handle. The initial binding uses setVariable, which exists on both revisions.
